text: Valhalla docs/source check: the server silently clamps any location radius, including exclude_locations radius, to its max_radius (default config 200 m). The app allows buffers up to 300 m (hub.13), so for 201-300 m buffers Valhalla only blocks roads within 200 m of a camera while the planner still counts cameras within the full buffer. What should happen above 200 m?
why: Keeps the interface as written and the result safe; only the 200-300 m slider range is weaker than it looks.
